id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|6f3: "Still, who'd have thought this would happen. What was the evil power that controlled the Pegasus statue...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|6fe: "Anyway, no amount of thanks is enough. Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|706: "Thank you for helping not only Grandpa but me too!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|70d: "I'll go back to the tower entrance first and give you a thank-you gift there. Please be sure to stop by.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|71b: You saved the old man and the horse! Return to the tower entrance and get a thank-you gift from the horse!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|72d: Amazing! {var:1} found the Crest of Life!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|733: But it seems best to leave this for this world's people. {var:1} put the Crest of Life back.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|74a: But it seems best to leave this for this world's people. {var:1} put the Lightning sword back.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|75f: But it seems best to leave this for this world's people. {var:1} put the Erdrick armour back.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|77c: "My lord's... command... destroy... destroy... this whole room... destroy it all!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|7ac: "Eek! I'm Cynthia! I'm not a slime!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|7b2: "...Oh, traveler! You came! Could you have brought the Archsage staff for me?!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|7c2: "...I see. I'm so scared my body is trembling like a real slime...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|7cc: "Sorry for rushing you. Before they find us, please bring the Archsage staff to me.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|7e9: "...It's filled with holy power. With this, the spell on me should break! Traveler, please use it now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|7fa: A pale light spreads from the Archsage staff and gently wraps the slime's body.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|803: The spell on Cynthia broke, and she returned to her girl form!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|80d: "Thank you, kind traveler! Thanks to you the spell broke and I'm back to normal!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|81a: "A token of my gratitude. Please accept it.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|83b: "Cynthia! You're safe! We searched so long! Did that monster hurt you?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|844: "...Hm? Who is that there? Why is that person with Cynthia?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|84b: "We searched and searched but never found her... the moment the slime vanished, she turns up with an outsider...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|856: "You... could you have something to do with that blue monster...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|85d: "I-I hate to say it, but did you team up with the blue monster and kidnap Cynthia?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|868: "That's it... it must be. Because this person is an outsider!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|86f: "N-no! Everyone, listen! This person helped me...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|877: "Cynthia! Step aside! We'll hear the details from him!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|87e: "...No one will listen. Traveler, it's dangerous here! Let's flee together for now!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|899: "Phew... we're safe this far. You saved my life. I won't let anyone hurt you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|8a7: "The villagers don't know I can use Moshas... so they panicked.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|8b0: "I'll persuade the villagers on your behalf. Traveler, wait here.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|8bb: Thanks to Cynthia's earnest persuasion, the misunderstanding about {var:1} was cleared.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|8c2: Thus peace returned to the mountain village...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|8ce: "Wait, traveler. You who saved Cynthia are a benefactor to her, no, to all us villagers.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|8f5: "Traveler, thank you for saving me. Thanks to you, peace has returned to the village.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|900: "...By the way, I'm practicing magic. Traveler, if you have time, could you help me practice Moshas?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|911: "...I see! You're busy, traveler. If you come to this village again, help me practice then. Promise.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|929: "Thank you, traveler! Then here I go...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|932: "...Hehe, how's that? It's a much better likeness than before, right?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|938: "With a Moshas this good, I think it'll help someone someday. I want to get better and better at Moshas.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|94f: "Hm...? Could it be you also admire my dazzling charisma?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|969: "Hm...? Could it be you also admire my dazzling charisma?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|956: "You look rather plain, but even I became this cool. You too can debut in the city and become charismatic!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|970: "You look rather plain, but even I became this cool. You too can debut in the city and become charismatic!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|97b: Use the Revealing herb on the fake Tania's brother?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|989: {var:1} threw the Revealing herb at the fake Tania's brother!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|9a2: "Gyeh gyeh gyeeh?! My looks aren't charismatic anymore, I tell ya!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|9a9: "That person's power made me a handsome man, so what's going on, I tell ya! Ugaah!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|9b2: The monster is furious. Fight this monster?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|9be: "I wanted to be a cool big bro so Tania would dote on me! You ruined it all, I tell ya!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|9c8: "I'll beat you black and blue, so brace yourself, I tell ya! Ugaah!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|9e4: "Thank you, traveler, for finding the Revealing herb and defeating my fake big brother!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|9f0: "Still, did that monster think I'd call him cool? He doesn't understand anything.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|9fb: "Because my big brother is cool just by being my usual big brother, hehe.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a02: "I've troubled you so much, traveler. Please accept this as thanks!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a0c: "Still, where could my real big brother have gone? He should be back by now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a18: "Well, I'll prepare for the spirits' festival and wait patiently. Thank you so much, traveler!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a29: But for now, choosing the bride comes first...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a3d: "By the way, {var:1}, I have one more favor to ask of you. Will you hear it?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a47: "The young groom is returning soon, but the thing is, we haven't chosen the bride yet.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a55: "It's the once-in-a-lifetime decision, and as the organizer I'd like to prepare myself... So.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a63: "I'd like to rehearse so we don't fail. Sorry, but could {var:1} and companions help?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a72: "I see, no good... Sorry for the imposing request.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a82: "Oh, you'll do it? As expected of the man I trusted!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a8b: "{var:1}, in place of the young man, choose someone to marry, treating your companions as brides.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|a99: "When you choose someone you want to marry, the rehearsal ends. I'll thank you properly afterward.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|aa9: "Now then... ahem. {var:1}, choose a marriage partner! Propose to whomever you like!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ab9: "...But, {var:1}, you have no companions with you now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ac3: "Sadly, I'll ask you to help with the rehearsal when you have companions. Count on me then.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ae3: "Gwahaha, weak, weak!! Even Rondarkia's monsters are nothing before my sword!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|aee: "Oh? You... have some backbone. I wander seeking the title of the strongest.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|afb: "Led by that person to this land, I finally obtained the legendary gear: Erdrick armour, Lightning sword, Crest of Life...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|b0b: "I am the wandering armour most worthy of the title of Erdrick!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|b13: "In place of the foolish being called a Luminary, I shall dye this world in terror worse than hell! Gwahaaa...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|b22: When the armored monster fell, the Crest of Life, Erdrick armour and Lightning sword were wrapped in holy light!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|b2e: You defeated the Restless Erdrick armour! Report to the soldier at the entrance of the Rondarkia cave!

id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|c07: "Hello, nice to meet you. I'm the Prince of Cannock.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|b6d: "...Could you be the Prince of Midenhall?! Ah, I've been looking for you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|c0e: "...Could you be the Prince of Midenhall?! Ah, I've been looking for you.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|b76: "Such dignity, surely a royal. You needn't say, I can tell. You must be the Prince of Midenhall...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|c17: "Such dignity, surely a royal. You needn't say, I can tell. You must be the Prince of Midenhall...

id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|c33: "Another miss... I really can't meet my companions...!

id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|c3e: "Following a mysterious voice in my head, I went to many worlds seeking the prince, but never found him...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|bae: "In desperation I ended up wandering this Forest of Bewilderment. I don't care what becomes of me anymore!

id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|cc8: "Uhyohyon. Indeed I am the Rebirth King. I'm searching for the eerie instrument that summons monsters, yon.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|cd6: "...Uhyon? Did the Etene folk send you, yon? No way, yon! I won't move the Hall of Gods monsters!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ce4: "I was told to hinder the Etene folk's reincarnation, yon. I can't defy that person's orders, yon!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|cf2: "Or maybe you'll fight me as a last resort, yon? If you beat me, the monsters in the Hall of Gods may vanish, yoyoyon!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|cff: "Uhyoooon! To think I'd lose... T-this is bad, yon...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d08: "I was hindering the Etene folk's reincarnation... now the monsters I summoned will va...nish, yon...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d15: You defeated the Rebirth King! Report to the Etene youth in the Hall of Gods!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d27: "I've been waiting. Did you get the Angel's tonic?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d32: "...I see. But I won't give up. I believe the medicine will come someday.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d52: "Let's use it on everyone right away. It'll reveal whether their opposition to the marriage is sincere or insanity.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d63: "I tried to settle this quietly, so why do you meddle?! If that's used, my magic will break!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d6f: "Enough! Making the townspeople object... such roundabout methods, no more!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d78: "I won't allow this marriage even if I must slaughter all of you!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d81: "Ugh... if that woman marries Ortega... a Luminary will be born.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|d89: "That alone... I wanted to stop at all costs...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|dac: "To think monsters were doing it to stop our marriage...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|db3: "Being driven mad by monsters caused the townspeople trouble too. We must restore them with the Angel's tonic...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|dc2: When the woman used the Angel's tonic, the people of Aliahan returned to their senses!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|dd2: "So the sudden urge to oppose the marriage was the monster's doing.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ddc: "That's right! There is no man as fine as Ortega. There's no reason to oppose their marriage!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|de6: "Sniff... I'm glad. My son isn't hated by everyone... I'm glad they bless the marriage like this.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|df2: "Thank you. It's thanks to you that the townspeople were brought back to their senses.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|dfa: "As thanks for your help, please accept this.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|e02: "By the way, that monster said if Ortega and I married, a Luminary would be born...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|e0d: "The monsters wary not only of Ortega but his descendants. I must grow strong enough to protect my family.

id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|e67: "At that moment, Lord Baramos shall revive! Devouring that soldier's body and the people's despair!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|e77: "Hm, who are you...? Could you have come to hinder Lord Baramos's revival?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|e91: "Hahaha, amusing! A sideshow to the revival ritual! I'll make you a sacrifice too!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ea2: "Huh?! The ritual participants are gone?! W-when did...!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|eac: "Damn you... this is your doing? You came to hinder Lord Baramos's revival?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ebf: "Liar! You defeated my puppets and still dare to say that!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ec9: "...But I'll forgive you just this once. Never hinder the ritual again!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|edd: "As I thought! Hindering the ritual and leaving me all alone is a grave sin...! I'll make you a sacrifice too!!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|eeb: "Y-you... who are you? Why do you have the power to defeat me...!?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ef5: "My ambition crushed in a place like this... Oooh... Lord Baramos...! Devour me... and revive...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|f02: You defeated the King Priest and stopped the ritual to revive Baramos! Report to the King of Portoga at the castle entrance!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|f29: "Oh, you've returned safely! The evil presence enveloping this castle is gone, and the roaming corpses are gone too.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|f38: "It's thanks to you defeating the ringleader who tried to revive Baramos!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|f41: "Splendid work this time! Now, accept your reward!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|f4a: "And, while I'm at it, I'll tell you the strange password carved into the castle wall, though I don't know its use.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|f5d: Baramos's Castle, as it was after the Altar of Legend, seems to be unlocked.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|f8c: "The King Priest's despair at his ritual being stopped was delicious. I revived because he offered his body and despair.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|f9c: "Now that the hero of Aliahan has vanished, no one in this world can defeat me...
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|fa8: "What is this... did you come to challenge me?
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|fb0: "Then leave! I'll let you go now.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|fbf: "Defying Archfiend Baramos... you don't know your place.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|fc9: "Regret coming here. I'll devour your innards!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|fd6: You defeated Archfiend Baramos! Report to the King of Portoga at the castle entrance!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|ff4: "You've returned safely! I heard from the soldiers. You defeated Archfiend Baramos!
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|100: "This time I was prepared for the end, but... you came, and I'm so grateful!
"Thanks to your deeds like the hero of Aliahan, the threat to this world is completely gone.

id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|10d: "Kyaah! Chasing me all this way, how persistent!

id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|125: "If everyone had kept sleeping, nobody could have gone to the fairy world deeper in this forest.
id./param/region/r024.pack|book_ie.bxon|126: "The fairies in the fairy village are truly grateful to you too. Thank you so much.

tm.「しかし こんなことが起きるとはのう。\n 天馬の像を あやつっていた 邪悪なチ: "Still, who'd have thought this would happen. What was the evil power that controlled the Pegasus statue...
tm.「とにかく あんたには\n 何度 お礼を言っても 足りんわい。\n どうも あり: "Anyway, no amount of thanks is enough. Thank you so much.
tm.「おじいさんだけでなく\n 私まで 助けていただいて\n ありがとうございました: "Thank you for helping not only Grandpa but me too!
tm.「先に 塔の入り口に戻っていますので\n そこで お礼の品を お渡しします。\n: "I'll go back to the tower entrance first and give you a thank-you gift there. Please be sure to stop by.
tm.おじいさんと ウマを助けた！\n塔の入り口まで戻って ウマから\nお礼の品を も: You saved the old man and the horse! Return to the tower entrance and get a thank-you gift from the horse!
tm.なんと！ {var:1}は\n命の紋章を 見つけた！: Amazing! {var:1} found the Crest of Life!
tm.しかし これは この世界の人たちのために\n残しておいたほうが よさそうだ。\n: But it seems best to leave this for this world's people. {var:1} put the Crest of Life back.
But it seems best to leave this for this world's people. {var:1} put the Lightning sword back.
But it seems best to leave this for this world's people. {var:1} put the Erdrick armour back.
tm.「我が主さまの……ご命令……\n こわす……こわす……\n この部屋……すべて: "My lord's... command... destroy... destroy... this whole room... destroy it all!
tm.「キャアっ！\n わたしは シンシア！\n スライムじゃないわっ！: "Eek! I'm Cynthia! I'm not a slime!
tm.「……って 旅人さん！ 来てくれたのね！\n もしかして わたしのために\n 大: "...Oh, traveler! You came! Could you have brought the Archsage staff for me?!
tm.「……そう。わたしったら こわくて\n 本物のスライムみたいに\n 身体が ぷる: "...I see. I'm so scared my body is trembling like a real slime...
tm.「急かしてしまって ごめんなさい。\n みんなに 見つかる前に\n 大賢者の杖を: "Sorry for rushing you. Before they find us, please bring the Archsage staff to me.
tm.「……聖なるチカラで 満ちている。\n これなら わたしにかかった魔法も解けるは: "...It's filled with holy power. With this, the spell on me should break! Traveler, please use it now.
tm.大賢者の杖から あわい光が放たれ\nスライムの身体を 優しく つつんだ。: A pale light spreads from the Archsage staff and gently wraps the slime's body.
tm.シンシアにかかっていた 魔法が解け\n元の少女の姿に 戻った！: The spell on Cynthia broke, and she returned to her girl form!
tm.「ありがとう！ 親切な旅人さん！\n あなたのおかげで 魔法が解けて\n 元の姿: "Thank you, kind traveler! Thanks to you the spell broke and I'm back to normal!
tm.「わたしの 感謝の気持ちよ。\n どうか 受け取って。: "A token of my gratitude. Please accept it.
tm.「シンシア！ 無事だったのか！\n ずいぶん 探したんだぞ！\n あの魔物に 乱: "Cynthia! You're safe! We searched so long! Did that monster hurt you?
tm.「……むむ？ そこにいるのは……誰だ？\n なぜ シンシアと一緒にいるのだ？: "...Hm? Who is that there? Why is that person with Cynthia?
tm.「あれだけ 探しても 見つからなかったのに\n ……スライムが いなくなったとた: "We searched and searched but never found her... the moment the slime vanished, she turns up with an outsider...
tm.「あんた……もしかして\n あの 青い魔物と関係が……: "You... could you have something to do with that blue monster...
tm.「ま…まさかとは 思うけど\n 青い魔物と一緒になって あんたが\n シンシアを: "I-I hate to say it, but did you team up with the blue monster and kidnap Cynthia?
tm.「そうだ……そうに 決まってる。\n だって この人は よそ者なんだから！: "That's it... it must be. Because this person is an outsider!
tm.「ち…違うわ！ みんな！ 話を聞いて！\n この人は わたしをっ……: "N-no! Everyone, listen! This person helped me...
tm.「シンシア！ そこをどきなさい！\n くわしい話は そいつに 聞くとしよう！: "Cynthia! Step aside! We'll hear the details from him!
tm.「……みんな 話を聞いてくれないわ。\n 旅人さん ここにいては 危険よ！\n: "...No one will listen. Traveler, it's dangerous here! Let's flee together for now!
tm.「ふう……ここまでくれば 大丈夫。\n あなたは 命の恩人ですもの。\n 誰にも: "Phew... we're safe this far. You saved my life. I won't let anyone hurt you.
tm.「村のみんなは わたしがモシャスを\n 使えることを知らないの……\n それで: "The villagers don't know I can use Moshas... so they panicked.
tm.「わたしが あなたの代わりに\n 村のみんなを 説得してみせるわ。\n 旅人さん: "I'll persuade the villagers on your behalf. Traveler, wait here.
tm.シンシアの 懸命な説得により\n{var:1}への誤解は 解けた。: Thanks to Cynthia's earnest persuasion, the misunderstanding about {var:1} was cleared.
tm.こうして 山奥の村に 平和が戻った……。: Thus peace returned to the mountain village...
tm.「待たれよ 旅のごじん。\n シンシアを助けてくれた おぬしは\n 彼女の……い: "Wait, traveler. You who saved Cynthia are a benefactor to her, no, to all us villagers.
tm.「旅人さん わたしを助けてくれて\n どうも ありがとう。\n おかげで 村に平: "Traveler, thank you for saving me. Thanks to you, peace has returned to the village.
tm.「……そうそう わたし 魔法の練習をしてるの。\n 旅人さん もし お時間がある: "...By the way, I'm practicing magic. Traveler, if you have time, could you help me practice Moshas?
tm.「……そっか！ 旅人さんは 忙しいのね。\n また この村に 来ることがあったら: "...I see! You're busy, traveler. If you come to this village again, help me practice then. Promise.
tm.「ありがとう！ 旅人さん！\n それじゃあ さっそく いくわよ……: "Thank you, traveler! Then here I go...
tm.「……えへへ どうかしら？\n 前よりも ずっと そっくりでしょう？: "...Hehe, how's that? It's a much better likeness than before, right?
tm.「これだけ 上手なモシャスなら\n いつか 誰かの役に立つと思うの。\n もっと: "With a Moshas this good, I think it'll help someone someday. I want to get better and better at Moshas.
tm.「うん……？ もしかして キミも\n ボクの この かがやくカリスマ性に\n あ: "Hm...? Could it be you also admire my dazzling charisma?
tm.「見たところ キミも そぼくな感じだけど\n ボクでも こんなに かっこよくなれ: "You look rather plain, but even I became this cool. You too can debut in the city and become charismatic!
tm.ニセモノの ターニアの兄に\nアバキ草を使いますか？: Use the Revealing herb on the fake Tania's brother?
tm.{var:1}は\nニセモノの ターニアの兄に向かって\nアバキ草を 投げつけた: {var:1} threw the Revealing herb at the fake Tania's brother!
tm.「ゲ ゲゲゲェーー！？\n いつの間にか オラの姿が\n カリスマじゃなくなって: "Gyeh gyeh gyeeh?! My looks aren't charismatic anymore, I tell ya!
tm.「あの方のチカラで せっかく\n イケメンに 変身させてもらったのに\n どうい: "That person's power made me a handsome man, so what's going on, I tell ya! Ugaah!!
tm.魔物は とても怒っている。\nこの魔物と 戦いますか？: The monster is furious. Fight this monster?
tm.「かっちょいい おにいちゃんになって\n ターニアちゃんに 甘えてもらいたかった: "I wanted to be a cool big bro so Tania would dote on me! You ruined it all, I tell ya!
tm.「おめえなんか メッタンメッタンの\n ギッチョンギッチョンに してやるから\n: "I'll beat you black and blue, so brace yourself, I tell ya! Ugaah!!
tm.「アバキ草を 見つけてきてくれた上に\n ニセモノの おにいちゃんを倒してくれて: "Thank you, traveler, for finding the Revealing herb and defeating my fake big brother!
tm.「それにしても あの魔物ったら\n かっこいいなんて 私が言うと思ったのかしら。: "Still, did that monster think I'd call him cool? He doesn't understand anything.
tm.「だって おにいちゃんは\n いつもの おにいちゃんだから\n かっこいいんだも: "Because my big brother is cool just by being my usual big brother, hehe.
tm.「旅人さんには すっかり\n お世話になっちゃった。\n これ お礼に受け取って: "I've troubled you so much, traveler. Please accept this as thanks!
tm.「それにしても…… 本物の おにいちゃんは\n いったい どこに行っちゃったのか: "Still, where could my real big brother have gone? He should be back by now.
tm.「まあ 精霊の祭りの 準備をしながら\n ゆっくり 待つことにするわ。\n 本当: "Well, I'll prepare for the spirits' festival and wait patiently. Thank you so much, traveler!
tm.しかし 今は とにかく\n花嫁を選ぶのが 先だろう……。: But for now, choosing the bride comes first...
tm.「時に {var:1}よ。\n じつは もうひとつ お前に\n 頼みごとがあるん: "By the way, {var:1}, I have one more favor to ask of you. Will you hear it?
tm.「もうすぐ帰ってくる 新郎の若者だが……。\n じつは 肝心の 相手の花嫁を\n: "The young groom is returning soon, but the thing is, we haven't chosen the bride yet.
tm.「なんせ 一生に一度の 重大な決断だ。\n それを仕切る私も 心がまえをしておき: "It's the once-in-a-lifetime decision, and as the organizer I'd like to prepare myself... So.
tm.「失敗せぬよう リハーサルをしようと思うのだ。\n 悪いが {var:1}と そ: "I'd like to rehearse so we don't fail. Sorry, but could {var:1} and companions help?
tm.「やはり ダメか……。\n ずうずうしい お願いをして\n すまなかったな。: "I see, no good... Sorry for the imposing request.
tm.「おお 引き受けてくれるか！\n さすがは 私が見込んだ男だ！: "Oh, you'll do it? As expected of the man I trusted!
tm.「{var:1}には その若者の代わりに\n 結婚したい者を 選んでほしいのだ。: "{var:1}, in place of the young man, choose someone to marry, treating your companions as brides.
tm.「{var:1}自身が 結婚したい相手を\n 選んだら リハーサル終了だ。\n: "When you choose someone you want to marry, the rehearsal ends. I'll thank you properly afterward.
tm.「それでは……コホン。\n {var:1}に 結婚相手を選んでもらおう！\n さ: "Now then... ahem. {var:1}, choose a marriage partner! Propose to whomever you like!
tm.「……と 思ったが {var:1}よ。\n 今 お前は ひとりも\n 仲間を 連: "...But, {var:1}, you have no companions with you now.
tm.「残念だが 仲間がいる時に\n 改めて リハーサルの手伝いを頼むとしよう。\n: "Sadly, I'll ask you to help with the rehearsal when you have companions. Count on me then.
tm.「グハハァァ 弱い 弱いィィ……！！\n ロンダルキアの魔物といえど\n 我が剣: "Gwahaha, weak, weak!! Even Rondarkia's monsters are nothing before my sword!
tm.「ほぉ？ 貴様は……。\n すこしは 骨がありそうだなァ。\n 我は 最強の称号: "Oh? You... have some backbone. I wander seeking the title of the strongest.
tm.「あの方に導かれ たどり着いた この地で\n ついに 最強と名高い武具 ロトのよ: "Led by that person to this land, I finally obtained the legendary gear: Erdrick armour, Lightning sword, Crest of Life...!
tm.「我こそは ロトの称号を得るに ふさわしい\n 最強の さまようよろいなりィ！: "I am the wandering armour most worthy of the title of Erdrick!
tm.「勇者などという たわけた存在に代わり\n この世界を 地獄すら生ぬるい恐怖で\: "In place of the foolish being called a Luminary, I shall dye this world in terror worse than hell! Gwahaaa...!
tm.よろいを着こんだ 魔物を倒すと\n命の紋章 ロトのよろい いなずまの剣は\n聖な: When the armored monster fell, the Crest of Life, Erdrick armour and Lightning sword were wrapped in holy light!
tm.さまようロトのよろいを倒した！\nロンダルキアの洞くつの 入り口にいる\n兵士に: You defeated the Restless Erdrick armour! Report to the soldier at the entrance of the Rondarkia cave!
tm.何者かが 木の根元を\n掘り起こしたような跡がある。: There are signs that someone dug up the base of the tree.
tm.「やあ はじめまして。\n ボクは サマルトリアの王子です。: "Hello, nice to meet you. I'm the Prince of Cannock.
tm.「……もしや キミは\n ローレシアの 王子ではっ！？\n いやー さがしました: "...Could you be the Prince of Midenhall?! Ah, I've been looking for you.
tm.「その 気品の高さは 間違いなく王族の方。\n 何も言わなくても ボクには わか: "Such dignity, surely a royal. You needn't say, I can tell. You must be the Prince of Midenhall...
tm.「……えっ？ あなたは たしかに 王族だけど\n ローレシアの王子ではなく\n: "...Huh? You're indeed royal, but not the Prince of Midenhall, rather the Prince of Dundrasil...?
tm.「そんな また からぶりだったなんて……。\n やっぱり ボクは 仲間たちに出会: "Another miss... I really can't meet my companions...!
tm.「アタマの中に響く 謎の声に したがって\n いろんな世界に行き 王子を探したけ: "Following a mysterious voice in my head, I went to many worlds seeking the prince, but never found him...
tm.「もう ヤケになって 気がつけば\n この迷いの森で さまよっていたんです……。: "In desperation I ended up wandering this Forest of Bewilderment. I don't care what becomes of me anymore!
tm.{var:1}の 手のアザが 光りだした！: The mark on {var:1}'s hand began to glow!
tm.勇者のチカラを使えば サマルトリアの王子を\nもとの世界に 戻してあげられそうだ: Using the Luminary's power may let you send the Prince of Cannock back to his own world. Use the Luminary's power?
tm.サマルトリアの王子は 勇者のチカラによって\n不思議な光に 包まれ……\nサマル: The Prince of Cannock was wrapped in a mysterious light by the Luminary's power and returned to Cannock Castle.
tm.{var:1}は サマルトリアの王子を\nもとの世界へと 戻した！\nサマルトリ: {var:1} sent the Prince of Cannock back to his own world! Report to the king in Cannock Castle!
tm.{var:1}の かすかに残った\n勇者のチカラが サマルトリアの王子の\nなげ: The faintly remaining Luminary's power in {var:1} is responding to the Prince of Cannock's lament...
tm.なんと！\n{var:1}の 手のアザが 光りだした！: Amazing! The mark on {var:1}'s hand began to glow!
tm.今なら 勇者のチカラで サマルトリアの王子を\nもとの世界に 戻してあげられそう: Now the Luminary's power may let you send the Prince of Cannock back to his own world. Use the Luminary's power?
tm.{var:1}は サマルトリアの王子を\nもとの世界に 戻すのを やめた。: {var:1} decided not to send the Prince of Cannock back to his own world.
tm.{var:1}の 勇者のチカラは\nふたたび 失われたようだ……。: {var:1}'s Luminary power seems to have been lost again...
tm.「ウヒョヒョン。いかにも ワチは転生大王。\n 魔物たちを呼びよせる あやかしの: "Uhyohyon. Indeed I am the Rebirth King. I'm searching for the eerie instrument that summons monsters, yon.
tm.「……ウヒョン？ チミは もしや\n エテーネの民に頼まれてきたヨン？ やだヨン: "...Uhyon? Did the Etene folk send you, yon? No way, yon! I won't move the Hall of Gods monsters!
tm.「だって エテーネの民の転生を ジャマしろって\n 言われたんだヨン。\n あの: "I was told to hinder the Etene folk's reincarnation, yon. I can't defy that person's orders, yon!
tm.「それとも ダメもとで ワチと戦ってみるヨン？\n ワチに勝ったら 神々の間の: "Or maybe you'll fight me as a last resort, yon? If you beat me, the monsters in the Hall of Gods may vanish, yoyoyon!!
tm.「ウヒョ～～ン！\n まさか ワチが 負けちゃうなんて……\n や…やばいヨン…: "Uhyoooon! To think I'd lose... T-this is bad, yon...
tm.「エテーネの民の転生を…… ジャマしてたのに\n このままじゃ…… 神々の間に呼: "I was hindering the Etene folk's reincarnation... now the monsters I summoned will va...nish, yon...
tm.転生大王を 倒した！\n神々の間にいる\nエテーネの民の青年に 報告しよう！: You defeated the Rebirth King! Report to the Etene youth in the Hall of Gods!
tm.「お待ちしておりました。\n もしかして 天使のきつけ薬が\n 手に入ったのです: "I've been waiting. Did you get the Angel's tonic?
tm.「……そうですか。\n でも 私は あきらめません。\n いつか 薬が手に入ると: "...I see. But I won't give up. I believe the medicine will come someday.
tm.「さっそく みなさんに 使ってみましょう。\n 結婚に反対しているのは 本心から: "Let's use it on everyone right away. It'll reveal whether their opposition to the marriage is sincere or insanity.
tm.「なるべく 穏便に済ませようとしたのに\n なぜ 余計なことをするのだ！\n そ: "I tried to settle this quietly, so why do you meddle?! If that's used, my magic will break!
tm.「ええいっ！\n 町の者たちに 反対させて……なんていう\n まどろこしいのは: "Enough! Making the townspeople object... such roundabout methods, no more!
tm.「お前たち 全員を 皆殺しにしてでも\n 結婚だけは 絶対に させんぞ！: "I won't allow this marriage even if I must slaughter all of you!
tm.「ぐっ……\n その女が オルテガと結婚すれば……\n 勇者が 生まれてしまう。: "Ugh... if that woman marries Ortega... a Luminary will be born.
tm.「それだけは……なんとしてでも\n 止めたかったのに……！: "That alone... I wanted to stop at all costs...!
tm.「まさか 魔物が 私たちの結婚を\n ジャマするために やっていたなんて……。: "To think monsters were doing it to stop our marriage...
tm.「魔物に 正気を失わされるなんて\n 町の人たちにも 迷惑をかけてしまったわ。\: "Being driven mad by monsters caused the townspeople trouble too. We must restore them with the Angel's tonic...
tm.女性が 天使のきつけ薬を使うと\nアリアハンの人々が 正気に戻った！: When the woman used the Angel's tonic, the people of Aliahan returned to their senses!
tm.「急に 結婚に 反対しなければならない\n 気になったのは 魔物のせいだったので: "So the sudden urge to oppose the marriage was the monster's doing.
tm.「そうじゃ！ オルテガほど 立派な男はおらん。\n ふたりの結婚に 反対する理由: "That's right! There is no man as fine as Ortega. There's no reason to oppose their marriage!
tm.「うっうっ……よかった……。\n わしの息子が 皆に嫌われておらんで……\n こ: "Sniff... I'm glad. My son isn't hated by everyone... I'm glad they bless the marriage like this.
tm.「ありがとうございます。\n 町の人たちを 正気に戻せたのは\n あなたのおかげ: "Thank you. It's thanks to you that the townspeople were brought back to their senses.
tm.「お世話になった お礼に\n こちらの品を 受け取ってください。: "As thanks for your help, please accept this.
tm.「そういえば あの魔物……\n オルテガさんと 私が 結婚すると\n 勇者が生ま: "By the way, that monster said if Ortega and I married, a Luminary would be born...
tm.「魔物たちは オルテガさんだけでなく\n その子孫まで 警戒しているのでしょう。: "The monsters wary not only of Ortega but his descendants. I must grow strong enough to protect my family.
tm.サンチョは 村人たちに\n最強のカゼぐすりを 飲ませて回った。: Sancho went around giving the villagers the ultimate cold medicine.
tm.村人たちのカゼは たちまち治り\n皆 歩けるほど 元気になった！: The villagers' colds were cured at once, and all were well enough to walk!
tm.これは 読んだ者の性格を\n変えることができる 不思議な本のようだ。: This seems to be a mysterious book that can change the reader's personality.
tm.{var:1}は\n『エッチなほん』を 手に入れた！\n必要な時に 使おう！: {var:1} got the "Racy book"! Use it when needed!
tm.「その時 魔王バラモスさまは 復活をとげる！\n そこの兵士の身体と 人々の絶望: "At that moment, Lord Baramos shall revive! Devouring that soldier's body and the people's despair!
tm.「むっ なんだ お前……？\n まさか バラモスさまの復活を\n ジャマしにきた: "Hm, who are you...? Could you have come to hinder Lord Baramos's revival?
tm.「ふははっ おもしろい！\n 復活の儀式の 余興だ！\n ついでに お前も いけ: "Hahaha, amusing! A sideshow to the revival ritual! I'll make you a sacrifice too!
tm.「ハッ！？\n 儀式をしていた者たちが いなくなってる！？\n い…いったい い: "Huh?! The ritual participants are gone?! W-when did...!
tm.「おのれ……お前の しわざだな？\n バラモスさまの復活を\n ジャマしにきたの: "Damn you... this is your doing? You came to hinder Lord Baramos's revival?
tm.「ウソつけっ！\n 私の 操り人形たちを倒しておいて\n よくも ぬけぬけと！！: "Liar! You defeated my puppets and still dare to say that!!
tm.「……だが 今回だけは 許してやろう。\n 二度と 儀式の ジャマをするでないぞ: "...But I'll forgive you just this once. Never hinder the ritual again!!
tm.「やはりな！ 儀式のジャマをした上\n 私を ひとりぼっちにさせた罪は 重い……: "As I thought! Hindering the ritual and leaving me all alone is a grave sin...! I'll make you a sacrifice too!!
tm.「お…お前 何者だ……。\n なぜ 私を倒せるチカラを 持っている……！？: "Y-you... who are you? Why do you have the power to defeat me...!?
tm.「こんな所で 私の野望が 打ち砕かれるとは……\n おぉぉ……バラモスさま……！: "My ambition crushed in a place like this... Oooh... Lord Baramos...! Devour me... and revive...
tm.キングプリーストを倒して\nバラモス復活の儀式を 食い止めた！\n城の入り口にい: You defeated the King Priest and stopped the ritual to revive Baramos! Report to the King of Portoga at the castle entrance!
tm.「おおっ よくぞ 無事で戻った！\n この城を包んでいた 邪悪な気配が消え\n: "Oh, you've returned safely! The evil presence enveloping this castle is gone, and the roaming corpses are gone too.
tm.「そなたが バラモスを復活させようとする親玉を\n 倒してくれた おかげじゃな！: "It's thanks to you defeating the ringleader who tried to revive Baramos!
tm.「こたびの はたらき 見事であった！\n さあ ほうびを 受け取るがいい！: "Splendid work this time! Now, accept your reward!
tm.「ついでじゃ！ 何に使うものかは わからんが\n 城のカベに 刻まれていた\n: "And, while I'm at it, I'll tell you the strange password carved into the castle wall, though I don't know its use.
tm.伝説への祭壇の\nその後のバラモス城が 解放されたようだ。: Baramos's Castle, as it was after the Altar of Legend, seems to be unlocked.
tm.「儀式を止められた キングプリーストの絶望は\n じつに美味だった。わしが 復活: "The King Priest's despair at his ritual being stopped was delicious. I revived because he offered his body and despair.
tm.「アリアハンの勇者が 姿を消した今\n この世界に わしを倒せる者は おらぬ……: "Now that the hero of Aliahan has vanished, no one in this world can defeat me...
tm.「なんじゃ そなたら……\n まさか わしに 挑みにきたのか？: "What is this... did you come to challenge me?
tm.「では 去れ！\n 今なら 見逃してやろう。: "Then leave! I'll let you go now.
tm.「この大魔王バラモスさまに 逆らおうなどと\n 身のほどを わきまえぬ 者たちじ: "Defying Archfiend Baramos... you don't know your place.
tm.「ここに来たことを くやむがよい。\n そなたらの ハラワタを\n 食らいつくし: "Regret coming here. I'll devour your innards!
tm.魔王バラモスを 倒した！\n城の入り口にいる ポルトガ王に 報告しよう！: You defeated Archfiend Baramos! Report to the King of Portoga at the castle entrance!
tm.「よくぞ 無事で戻った！\n 兵士から 報告は受けておる。\n 魔王バラモスを: "You've returned safely! I heard from the soldiers. You defeated Archfiend Baramos!
tm.「今回ばかりは おしまいかと\n 覚悟を 決めていたが……\n そなたが来てくれ: "This time I was prepared for the end, but... you came, and I'm so grateful!
tm.「そなたが アリアハンの勇者のような\n 活躍をしてくれたおかげで\n この世界: "Thanks to your deeds like the hero of Aliahan, the threat to this world is completely gone.
tm.「こたびの はたらきも 見事であった！\n さあ ほうびを 受け取るがいい！: "Splendid work again! Now, accept your reward!
tm.「オホホ。\n このカメは 興味深いですね。\n じつに おもしろいチカラを感じ: "Ohoho. This turtle is interesting. I sense a very interesting power...
tm.「なっ なんですか あなたは……。\n まさか エテーネの村から\n このカメを: "W-what are you? Could you have come from Etene Village to rescue this turtle?
tm.「そうですか……。\n 私の敵じゃないなら 問題ありません。\n さっさと向こう: "I see... if you're not my enemy, no problem. Now go away over there!
tm.「キィーッ！\n こんな遠くまで 追いかけてくるなんて\n しつこい人ですねっ！: "Kyaah! Chasing me all this way, how persistent!
tm.「仕方がありません。\n 実力行使なんて 野蛮ですが……\n 私たちが 相手にな: "It can't be helped. Violence is barbaric, but... we will be your opponents!!
tm.「お…おのれ……！\n エテーネの村の カメを さらえば……: "D-damn you...! If we take Etene Village's turtle...
tm.「レンダーシアの勇者に 手を貸す者が……\n いなくなる……はず だったのに……: "Those who aid the Erdrean Luminary would be gone... was the plan...
tm.カメさまが 優しい目で\nじっと こちらを見つめている……。\nどうやら 感謝し: The Turtle Lord is gazing at you with gentle eyes... He seems to be grateful.
tm.{var:1}は ルーラストーンを使い\nカメさまと共に エテーネの村に戻った！: {var:1} used a Zoom stone and returned to Etene Village with the Turtle Lord!
tm.ろぜしのう やざじりちとた\n あゆしいは まのへ\n＊「これを 書きとめ: "ろぜしのう　やざじりちとた⏎あゆしいは　まのへ⏎＊「Write this down.
tm.天馬の像に おかしな様子はない。\n静かに 心の持ち主の帰りを\n待っているよう: Nothing seems wrong with the Pegasus statue. It quietly seems to await its master's return.
tm.「……何をしに来た？\n ここは 我の 呪われし楽園。\n ジャマだてすると 容: "...What do you want? This is my cursed paradise. Interfere and I show no mercy!
tm.あくまのきしを 倒したことで\nよみがえった人たちは ふたたび\n静かな眠りに: With the Psaro knight defeated, the revived people seem to have returned to quiet sleep.
tm.ドムドーラに眠る人々を 苦しめていた\nあくまのきしを倒した！\n町の入り口にい: You defeated the Psaro knight tormenting the people sleeping in Domdora! Report to the client at the town entrance!
tm.「ガハハ！ こいつぁ いいや！\n この ぎんのたてごとを かき鳴らせば\n 客: "Gahaha! This is great! Strum this Silver harp and customers keep coming!
tm.「……お！ なんだなんだ 人間の客か。\n お前も オレの歌を聞きたくて 来たの: "...Oh! What, a human customer. Did you come to hear my song too?
tm.「……なんだって？ ぎんのたてごとを返せだと！\n バカ言っちゃ いけねえや！\: "...What? Return the Silver harp?! Don't be silly! I won't give back such a dreamy instrument!
tm.「オレは ドラムゴート族の はみだしもん……。\n 生まれつき 音痴で\n 誰も: "I'm an outcast of the Drum goat tribe... tone-deaf from birth, nobody would listen to my songs.
tm.「だが この ぎんのたてごとがあれば\n オレの歌を聞かせる客に こまることはね: "But with this Silver harp I'll never lack an audience! I'll hold recitals every night!
tm.「ジャマするヤツは 容赦しねえ！\n オレさまの魂のビート その身に刻みやがれ！: "I show no mercy to anyone in my way! Feel the beat of my soul! Ugaaaan!
tm.ぎんのたてごとを盗んだ 魔物を倒した！\nガライの町にいる おじいさんに\n倒し: You defeated the monster that stole the Silver harp! Report to the old man in Garin Town!
tm.この先は真っ暗で 進めそうにない。: It's pitch black ahead and you can't proceed.
tm.ここから先は 行かないほうが よさそうだ。: It seems best not to go beyond here.
tm.地下には 特に何もなさそうだ。: There seems to be nothing special underground.
tm.宝箱には カギが かかっている！\nとても大事なものが 入っているようだ。: The chest is locked! Something very important seems to be inside.
tm.「ゆ…ゆるしてくれ！ オラは ただ\n 青い ツンツン頭の兄貴に化けて\n ター: "P-please forgive me! I just wanted to disguise as a blue spiky-haired big bro to be liked by Tania, I tell ya!
tm.「オラ もう 悪さしねえって約束する！\n だから どうか見逃してくんろ！\n: "I promise I won't do bad things anymore! So please let me off, I tell ya! Please! Please!?
tm.「そんな！ あんた 見かけによらず\n イケズなこと言う人だど！\n オラ ムネ: "No way! You're meaner than you look, I tell ya! My chest feels like it'll burst!
tm.「ありがてえ！ あんた\n ターニアちゃんの次くらいに 優しいな！\n 心の友と: "Thank ya! You're the kindest after Tania! Let me call you my heart's friend!
tm.「というワケで……。\n オラは このへんで おいとまするど！\n それでは さ: "So... I'll take my leave here! Farewell, my heart's friend!
tm.「ちょっと どこに行くのよ {var:1}。\n 妖精さんは 悪さしてる花が咲い: "Hey, where are you going, {var:1}? The fairy says the bad flower is this way.
tm.「あのまま みんなが眠りつづけてたら\n この森の奥に広がる 妖精の世界へ\n: "If everyone had kept sleeping, nobody could have gone to the fairy world deeper in this forest.
tm.「妖精の村に住む 妖精たちも\n 心から あなたに感謝しているわ。\n ホントに: "The fairies in the fairy village are truly grateful to you too. Thank you so much.
